text:
maria_clarity: Hey team — ClarityLabs here. We have a customer demo hitting Seattle region tomorrow at 10:00 PDT. Can we get an allowlist + temporary QPS bump for their IPs? Need it pre-warmed by 09:30 if possible.

emma_cs: @maria_clarity yep — can you paste the source IPs and the org id? Also how big a bump do you need (baseline qps -> target)?

maria_clarity: Org: CLAR-983. IPs: 18.205.0.12, 52.54.23.0/24 (their CDN). Baseline is ~20 qps, expecting spikes to ~180 qps for 30m. So target 200 qps window for 1 hour.

emma_cs: Got it. Sounds reasonable as a short-lived demo bump. We'll do: 200 qps for 1 hour, add CIDR allowlist and a header-based relax for `x-clarity-demo: true`. ETA to complete change? pinging ops.

sanjay_ops: Looping in neteng to add the CIDR and header exemption. We'll need a ticket with the exact JSON for the allowlist and a start/end epoch. Also confirm whether they need regional pinning to us-west-2 edge.

kai_neteng: I can add the CIDR and header rule. Proposed start: 2026-03-24T16:30:00Z (09:30 PDT) end: 2026-03-24T17:30:00Z. Confirming the exact CIDR: 52.54.23.0/24. I will also pin routing to SEA region to avoid cross-region egress.

emma_cs: Confirmed. Maria — can you confirm TOS + that payloads don't contain PII for the demo? We need that for temporary relaxations.

maria_clarity: Confirmed — demo uses synthetic data, no PII. TOS accepted. Thanks.

sanjay_ops: Here's the allowlist snippet I'll use when creating the ticket (doing as an example):

```
{
  "org_id": "CLAR-983",
  "allowlist": {
    "cidrs": ["52.54.23.0/24", "18.205.0.12/32"],
    "header_whitelist": [{"header": "x-clarity-demo", "value": "true"}]
  },
  "qps_override": 200,
  "duration_minutes": 60,
  "region_pin": "us-west-2"
}
```

kai_neteng: That looks fine. I'll create infra change CHG-6421 and schedule a deployment window for 16:20Z to pre-warm caches and KV.

infra-bot: CHG-6421 created by kai_neteng. Window: 2026-03-24T16:20:00Z - 2026-03-24T17:40:00Z. Approvers: @sanjay_ops, @emma_cs.

emma_cs: Approved. @sanjay_ops can you validate the throttles live and share a quick smoke test URL?

sanjay_ops: Will do. Plan: run a 5-min loadgen 160 qps against demo route at 16:25Z, monitor 95p latency and error rate. I will post results here.

infra-bot: Deploy started for CHG-6421 at 2026-03-24T16:22:30Z.

sanjay_ops: Loadgen ran at 16:25Z — sustained 160 qps, 95p latency 120ms, errors 0. Smoke looks good.

infra-bot: Allowlist and QPS override applied to org CLAR-983 at 2026-03-24T16:26:05Z. Rule id: ALW-83827. Auto-revoke scheduled at 2026-03-24T17:30:00Z.

maria_clarity: Amazing — confirmed demo traffic is flowing. Team is happy. Thank you all :raised_hands:

emma_cs: Great. I'll follow up after the demo with a short doc capturing the temporary change and renewal risk note. Maria — do you want this repeated for future demos? We can provide a reusable staging key.

maria_clarity: Yes please — a reusable staging key would help. Also can you send the post-demo usage summary?

emma_cs: Will do. Closing thread after post-demo report.

infra-bot: CHG-6421 closed at 2026-03-24T17:30:10Z (auto-revoke executed).
